units: source-image pixels; top-left origin; right +x, down +y
floor_construction: Full room planes rebuilt from unobstructed source floor cells; obscured floors are not original hidden pixels.
wall_construction: Visual source wall footprints retained. Obscured facade textures completed from source stone samples.
limitations: Flattened source does not contain hidden geometry. Completed floor/wall surfaces are documented reconstructions.
NPC source contains eight single front-facing poses, not movement animations.
Some props are assemblies (dining sets, computer desk, exercise fence, energy pipes); their components share one sprite.
No authoritative GM was supplied in this extraction request. Source visual coordinates are preserved; collision shapes are not inferred.
Wall images include cap and front elevation; use engine sorting/occlusion as described in README.
